settings.section_content:
Your name, email, phone number and delivery address when you place an order. Your cat's name, age and food preferences if you choose to tell us. Basic information about how you use the site, pages viewed, device type, rough location from your IP.
We do not store your card or UPI details. Those go straight to our payment gateway, and never touch our servers.

To deliver your order and tell you where it is. To recommend the right food for your cat's life stage. To answer you when you write in. To fix things that break on the site, and to work out which products people actually want.
Marketing emails and WhatsApp updates only go out if you opt in, and every one of them has an unsubscribe link.

Only the people who need it to get your order to you:

  • Our delivery partners, who get your name, address and phone number
  • Our payment gateway, which handles the transaction
  • The tools we use to run the shop and send email
  • Government authorities, if the law requires it

That's the whole list. We don't sell your data, we don't rent it, and we don't hand it to advertisers.

We use cookies to keep your cart alive between visits, remember you're logged in, and see which pages work. You can turn off the non-essential ones from the cookie banner or in your browser settings, the site will still work, your cart just won't follow you around.

settings.section_heading: What you can ask us to do
settings.section_content:
Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you can ask us to show you what we hold, correct anything wrong, delete your account and everything attached to it, or stop sending you marketing.
Write to privacy@purrkins.com and we'll action it within 30 days. If we can't, we'll tell you why.
Order records stay for 7years because tax law says so. Everything else, your profile, your cat's details, your preferences, goes within 30 days of you asking us to delete it.
